name: Chatbox
description: Desktop chat client with document conversations, model switching, and support for local or hosted providers
evidence: Official README links Intel and Apple Silicon installers on the product website; community and commercial editions differ. [Release v1.23.5](https://github.com/chatboxai/chatbox/releases/tag/v1.23.5) published 2026-09-24. [User report](https://github.com/chatboxai/chatbox/issues/3969) documents real product use or feature requests.

name: ChatGPT
description: Conversational assistant for research, writing, coding, and working with files
evidence: Desktop and mobile download links; live chat service.

name: Cherry Studio
description: Multi-model desktop workspace with document knowledge bases, reusable assistants, and agent workflows
evidence: Release includes Mac ARM64 and Intel installers; README documents Windows and Linux support. [Release v2.1.4](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/releases/tag/v2.1.4) published 2026-09-30. [User report](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues/21305) documents real product use or feature requests.

name: Claude
description: Assistant for document analysis, writing, coding, and extended conversations
evidence: Mac, Windows, Apple and Google Play downloads; live Claude login.

name: Enchanted
description: Native Apple chat client for connecting to an Ollama server, with keyboard access and prompt templates

name: macai
description: Native Mac chat client with provider switching, reusable prompts, and optional iCloud conversation sync
evidence: Universal Mac binary, macOS 14 or later, Intel and Apple Silicon; hosted providers require separate API credentials. name: Monica
description: Desktop AI assistant for multi-model chat, writing, translation, and document summaries
evidence: Official download page explicitly lists standalone Mac and Windows desktop apps in addition to separate browser and mobile products.

name: Msty Studio
description: Desktop workspace for comparing local and hosted models, organizing document knowledge, and reusing prompts
evidence: Official Mac Intel/Apple Silicon, Windows, and Linux installers. [Changelog](https://msty.ai/resources/changelog/studio) records 2.9.6 on 2026-07-24; a [community integration](https://github.com/M-Pineapple/msty-admin-mcp) documents actual Studio workflows.

name: Perplexity
description: Desktop research assistant with cited answers and tools for working with local files and apps
evidence: Official Personal Computer page documents the Perplexity Mac desktop app and setup route, with macOS 15 or later required. Cloud features and plan limits apply.

name: Poe
description: Desktop chat client for using multiple AI models and discovering custom bots
evidence: Official Get Poe page links separate macOS and Windows desktop installers on the Poe CDN.

name: Cline
description: Desktop coding agent that edits files, runs tools, and manages agent sessions with approval controls
evidence: Official README links Mac and Windows desktop downloads, editor marketplaces, and the CLI; Mac universal DMG is available. [Release desktop-v0.0.43](https://github.com/cline/cline/releases/tag/desktop-v0.0.43) published 2026-10-02. [User report](https://github.com/cline/cline/issues/14806) documents real product use or feature requests.

name: Cursor
description: Desktop code editor and agent workspace for editing, understanding, and building software
evidence: Current desktop downloads for all three operating systems, terminal installer, and web entry point.

name: OpenCode
description: Desktop coding agent with multiple model providers and project-aware tools
evidence: README documents Mac Intel and Apple Silicon desktop downloads, Windows and Linux packages, and CLI installation. [Release v1.18.34](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.18.34) published 2026-09-30. [User report](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/52965) documents real product use or feature requests.

name: Zed
description: Collaborative code editor with integrated agents and AI-assisted editing
evidence: Explicit macOS, Linux, and Windows availability; download and source links.

description: Writing assistant for improving wording, grammar, tone, and style

name: Grammarly
description: Writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and drafting across everyday work
evidence: Live writing product, signup, and supported integrations. Mac availability additionally checked against the official [Mac app page](https://www.grammarly.com/desktop/mac).

name: Comfy Desktop
description: Desktop manager for building node-based image and video generation workflows with separate ComfyUI environments
evidence: Current successor to the archived Comfy-Org/desktop repository; README links the official installer and documents Apple Silicon Mac support and GPU requirements. [Release v1.1.6](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/Comfy-Desktop/releases/tag/v1.1.6) published 2026-10-03.

name: Draw Things
description: Apple app for local image and video generation, inpainting, model customization, and LoRA training
evidence: Official source repository links the Mac/iOS app; [release v26.0928.0](https://github.com/drawthingsai/draw-things-community/releases/tag/v26.0928.0) dated 2026-09-28. [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/draw-things-offline-ai-art/id6444050820) has user reviews. Local creation and optional cloud services have different requirements.

name: Buzz
description: Desktop transcription and translation tool with offline speech recognition and subtitle export
evidence: Release provides Mac ARM64 and Intel DMGs plus Windows and Linux packages. [Release v1.4.5](https://github.com/chidiwilliams/buzz/releases/tag/v1.4.5) published 2026-08-23. [User report](https://github.com/chidiwilliams/buzz/issues/1642) documents real product use or feature requests.

name: Descript
description: Audio and video editor with text-based editing, transcription, and AI production tools
evidence: Current desktop downloads; product page describes transcription and AI editing.

evidence: README documents offline recognition, downloadable speech models, global shortcuts, and Mac installation through a DMG or Homebrew. [Release v0.9.8](https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/releases/tag/v0.9.8) published 2026-10-03. [User report](https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/issues/2198) documents real product use or feature requests.

evidence: Mac app download and transcription features.

evidence: Mac DMG and Windows/Linux release packages; mobile recording uses a browser connection and is not labeled as a native mobile app. [Release v3.2.2](https://github.com/thewh1teagle/vibe/releases/tag/v3.2.2) published 2026-09-05. [User report](https://github.com/thewh1teagle/vibe/issues/1623) documents real product use or feature requests.

[User report](https://github.com/Beingpax/VoiceInk/issues/991) documents real product use or feature requests.

evidence: Official downloads for Mac, Windows, iPhone, and Android; named customer examples on the product page. [Product updates](https://wisprflow.ai/whats-new) dated 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-15 confirm ongoing speech and meeting features; hosted processing and subscription terms apply.

description: Workspace for chatting with documents and running agents with local or connected models

evidence: Current LM Studio download and release notes, separate from the Bionic agent.

description: Native Apple Silicon workspace for local MLX chat, model management, and compatible inference APIs
evidence: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later; official DMG, bundled local runtime, and documented model setup. GitHub reports 743 downloads of Nativ-0.3.11.dmg at review time; downloads are an adoption signal, not unique users.

description: Desktop app for running local models and connecting them to chat apps, with an accompanying API and CLI
evidence: Official macOS documentation describes the DMG and Applications-folder GUI installation; [Windows documentation](https://docs.ollama.com/windows) describes its native app. Linux offers a CLI/server and is not tagged as a desktop app.

description: Mac assistant that combines contextual AI actions, dictation, knowledge tools, and automated workflows across apps
evidence: Official Mac download, pricing, and customer testimonials. [Changelog](https://www.enconvo.com/changelog) documents release 2.5.5 on 2026-09-10 and desktop feature updates. The official [GitHub organization](https://github.com/Enconvo) hosts extensions; this does not imply the full app is open source.

evidence: Current AAIF repository, formerly block/goose; README documents desktop installers and CLI setup for the supported systems.
